notes.Winter Storm Fern: Jan 24–26, 2026: Arctic storm across the eastern two-thirds of the U.S.; production freeze-offs and record heating demand sent Henry Hub spot above $30/MMBtu on Jan 23.
notes.Golden Pass LNG first cargo: Apr 22, 2026: the 10th U.S. LNG export terminal (Texas) shipped its first cargo, adding Gulf Coast export demand.
notes.Record-hot July: July 2026: warmest July on record for the Lower 48 (NOAA); power-sector gas burn rose, but record production kept summer prices near $3.
notes.China 15% tariff on US LNG: Feb 10, 2025: China's retaliatory tariff on U.S. LNG took effect.
